recentItems.description:
🍿 Watch the rest of the full series on BBC iPlayer now ➡️ https://www.bbc.co.uk/iplayer/episodes/m0031480/krapopolis  

Set in mythical Ancient Greece, the series centres on a flawed family of humans, gods and monsters that tries to run one of the world's first cities without killing each other.

Krapopolis is an animated comedy created by Dan Harmon (Rick and Morty, Community) .
